home_hero_subtitle: A secure sign-in layer for Minecraft communities, with web, OAuth, and passkey authentication.
feature_signed_sessions_desc: A unified login flow for community-managed server access.
feature_oauth_login_desc: Connect with GitHub, Google, or Microsoft for instant access.
feature_passkeys_desc: No passwords? No problem. Use FaceID or TouchID.
why_beaconauth_desc: Designed to bring everyone together. Secure, modern, and inclusive authentication for your community.
card_multi_auth_desc: Let server operators require BeaconAuth for modded clients while allowing already-verified vanilla connections when configured.
card_enterprise_security_desc: Your account safety is our priority. Industry-standard encryption keeps your data safe.
card_seamless_integration_desc: Install the mod and never type a command again. It just works.
cta_desc: Experience the future of Minecraft server authentication.
settings_login_required: Please log in to access settings.
settings_subtitle: Manage your password and passkeys for {username}
settings_profile_desc: Set an optional email for display and Gravatar, and choose where your avatar comes from.
settings_email_tooltip: Email is used only for display and Gravatar. BeaconAuth does not verify it and it is not used for login or proving ownership.
settings_change_username_desc: 3-16 characters. Letters, numbers, and underscore only. Usernames are unique case-insensitively.
settings_login_methods_desc: Link or unlink login methods. All methods are equal — keep at least one enabled so you don't lock yourself out.
settings_no_providers: No OAuth providers configured on the server.
settings_passkeys_desc: Use biometric authentication for passwordless login
settings_add_passkey_promo: Add a passkey for faster, more secure authentication
settings_passkeys_help_text: Passkeys are a secure, passwordless authentication method that uses your device's biometric authentication (fingerprint, face recognition) or PIN. They're more secure than passwords and easier to use.
settings_add_new_passkey_desc: Give your passkey a memorable name to identify this device.
alert_confirm_unlink: Are you sure you want to unlink this login method?
alert_confirm_delete_passkey: Are you sure you want to delete passkey "{name}"?
oauth_complete_auth_success_profile: Authentication successful! Redirecting to your profile...
oauth_complete_auth_error: An error occurred during authentication. Please try again.
oauth_complete_subtitle_minecraft: You can switch back to Minecraft now.
settings_validation_password_min_length: Password must be at least {min} characters
settings_validation_username_min_length: Username must be at least {min} characters
settings_validation_username_max_length: Username must be at most {max} characters
settings_validation_username_invalid_cha: Username can only contain letters, numbers, and underscore
settings_error_failed_start_oauth_link_f: Failed to start OAuth link flow
settings_alert_set_password_info: You currently log in with social accounts. Set a password to log in with username/password as well.
error_page_invalid_request_desc_line1: This page requires valid challenge and redirect_port parameters.
error_page_invalid_request_desc_line2: Please access this page through the Minecraft mod.
command_palette_description: Search for a command to run...
minecraft_flow_desc: Once you finish, you'll be sent back to the game automatically.
login_oidc_failed_desc: Something went wrong while connecting to the game. Please try signing in again.
login_passkey_registered_desc: A passkey was added to your account on this device.
settings_identity_mode_desc: Choose which identity you use on servers that migrated from offline mode. The real Mojang UUID is the default; the legacy identity preserves world data from an offline-mode server.
settings_identity_mode_not_configured: Minecraft login is not configured on this server.
settings_identity_mode_not_linked: Link a Minecraft account to choose your identity.
settings_identity_mode_error: Failed to save Minecraft identity preference.
